page.overview:
What is Unrevisitable locations?

Unrevisitable locations are locations accessed automatically during the storyline that become inaccessible after a certain point in the game. Many unofficial guides and walkthroughs warn players of these locations beforehand, especially if they contain useful items that could potentially be missable.

The Dreadnought, the Palamecian Empire's airship, is destroyed by the player party. The Rebel Camp near Gatrea is only accessible right before Castle Fynn is liberated. Leviathan, the sea monster from whose bowels the party must escape, becomes inaccessible after defeating the boss. After the player party obtains Ultima in the Mysidian Tower, Altair, Gatrea, Paloom, and Poft are destroyed by the Cyclone, which in turn is destroyed by the Wild Rose Rebellion. Palamecia Castle is replaced by Pandaemonium after the party escapes from it.

There are some unrevisitable locations: the Dragon's Peak after the party jumps off Bahamut's nest with Desch (in the 3D and Pixel Remaster versions, only the nest is unrevisitable), the rooms that require Mini within the Nepto Temple after defeating the giant rat and leaving with the eye (only in the Famicom version; in all other versions, the entire temple can be revisited), the Subterranean Lake after exiting with the Horn of Ice (only in the Famicom version; in all other versions, the lake can still be entered), Castle Hein and the Living Woods after the Elder Tree is restored, the Wrecked Ship after defeating Kraken, the Cave of the Circle after completing it (only in the Famicom version; in all other versions, the cave remains accessible), Lake Dohr after Leviathan is defeated and the player leaves the area (except in the Pixel Remaster version, where it can be revisited), and Doga's Grotto, which disappears once the player has obtained the Eureka and Sycrus keys and exits the dungeon. Also, the World of Darkness, the final area, has no exit other than the game's end.

There are four unrevisitable locations: the Tower of Zot, the two portions of the Tower of Babil, and the Giant of Babil. Although three of those four locations become inaccessible as soon as they're completed, the lower section of the Tower of Babil can actually be revisited up until the player completes the Sealed Cave. Due to a glitch in some versions, Kain's Trial becomes unrevisitable if the player defeats Dark Kain using the Tornado activated by Abel's Lance.
